legend.0: Quiet: nobody queued at the gate and fewer than half the pallets taken on a normal day; spare capacity is going unused.
legend.1: Ordinary demand: at most a couple of cars queued and roughly half to three quarters of the pallets taken.
legend.2: Busy: several cars queued or most pallets taken, as in rush hour.
legend.3: Overloaded: a long queue with the towers nearly full, or capacity squeezed by a power cut or a robotaxi fleet arriving at once.

legend.2: Busy: several cars queued or most pallets taken, as in rush hour.
legend.3: Overloaded: a long queue with the towers nearly full, or capacity squeezed by a power cut or a robotaxi fleet arriving at once.

legend.2: Busy: several cars queued or most pallets taken, as in rush hour.
legend.3: Overloaded: a long queue with the towers nearly full, or capacity squeezed by a power cut or a robotaxi fleet arriving at once.

legend.2: Busy: several cars queued or most pallets taken, as in rush hour.
legend.3: Overloaded: a long queue with the towers nearly full, or capacity squeezed by a power cut or a robotaxi fleet arriving at once.

legend.2: Busy: several cars queued or most pallets taken, as in rush hour.
legend.3: Overloaded: a long queue with the towers nearly full, or capacity squeezed by a power cut or a robotaxi fleet arriving at once.

legend.2: Busy: several cars queued or most pallets taken, as in rush hour.
legend.3: Overloaded: a long queue with the towers nearly full, or capacity squeezed by a power cut or a robotaxi fleet arriving at once.

legend.2: Busy: several cars queued or most pallets taken, as in rush hour.
legend.3: Overloaded: a long queue with the towers nearly full, or capacity squeezed by a power cut or a robotaxi fleet arriving at once.

legend.2: Busy: several cars queued or most pallets taken, as in rush hour.
legend.3: Overloaded: a long queue with the towers nearly full, or capacity squeezed by a power cut or a robotaxi fleet arriving at once.

legend.2: Busy: several cars queued or most pallets taken, as in rush hour.
legend.3: Overloaded: a long queue with the towers nearly full, or capacity squeezed by a power cut or a robotaxi fleet arriving at once.

legend.2: Busy: several cars queued or most pallets taken, as in rush hour.
legend.3: Overloaded: a long queue with the towers nearly full, or capacity squeezed by a power cut or a robotaxi fleet arriving at once.

legend.2: Busy: several cars queued or most pallets taken, as in rush hour.
legend.3: Overloaded: a long queue with the towers nearly full, or capacity squeezed by a power cut or a robotaxi fleet arriving at once.

legend.2: Busy: several cars queued or most pallets taken, as in rush hour.
legend.3: Overloaded: a long queue with the towers nearly full, or capacity squeezed by a power cut or a robotaxi fleet arriving at once.
